q_A: SELECT name FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY Level_of_membership DESC
gold_q_B: SELECT "visitor"."Name" AS "name" FROM "visitor" AS "visitor" WHERE "visitor"."lvl_mem" > 4 ORDER BY "visitor"."lvl_mem" DESC

q_A: SELECT avg(age) FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership <= 4
gold_q_B: SELECT AVG("visitor"."Age") AS "_col_0" FROM "visitor" AS "visitor" WHERE "visitor"."lvl_mem" <= 4

q_A: SELECT name , Level_of_membership FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY age DESC
gold_q_B: SELECT "visitor"."Name" AS "name", "visitor"."lvl_mem" AS "level_of_membership" FROM "visitor" AS "visitor" WHERE "visitor"."lvl_mem" > 4 ORDER BY "visitor"."Age" DESC

q_A: SELECT museum_id , name FROM museum ORDER BY num_of_staff DESC LIMIT 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."mus_id" AS "museum_id", "museum"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "museum" ORDER BY "museum"."Num_of_Staff" DESC LIMIT 1

q_A: SELECT t2.visitor_id , t1.name , t1.Level_of_membership FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id GROUP BY t2.visitor_id ORDER BY sum(t2.Total_spent) DESC LIMIT 1

q_A: SELECT t2.Museum_ID , t1.name FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID GROUP BY t2.Museum_ID ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q_A: SELECT name FROM museum WHERE Museum_ID NOT IN (SELECT museum_id FROM visit)

q_A: SELECT sum(t2.Total_spent) FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id WHERE t1.Level_of_membership = 1
